gloss: use of funds; how money is spent

definitions.gloss: use of funds; how money is spent
definitions.explanation: What money, especially public or donated money, is spent on.

examples.japanese: {使途|しと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あき}らかにする→明らかにする：22256_akirakanisuru⟧。
examples.english: To disclose how the money was spent.

examples.japanese: {寄付金|きふきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使途|しと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: How the donations were used was made public.

examples.japanese: {政治資金|せいじしきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使途|しと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不透明|ふとうめい}→不透明：11365_futoumei⟧だとして、⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The opposition is demanding an explanation, saying it is unclear how the political funds were spent.

notes:
A formal word of news, accounting and administration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {使途|しと}{不明金|ふめいきん}: unaccounted-for money
- {使途|しと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to disclose how money is used
- {使途|しと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}する→限定する：19626_genteisuru⟧: to restrict what money can be used for

WATCH OUT:
The homophone ⟦{使徒|しと}→使徒：26243_shito⟧ means apostle.
